documents.title: VIT Chennai IEEE Chapters — IEEE RAS
documents.text: IEEE Robotics and Automation Society (IEEE-RAS) objectives are scientific, literary and educational. The society strives for advancement of the theory and practice of robotics and automation engineering and science and allied arts and sciences. Its mission is to foster development and facilitate exchange of scientific and technological knowledge in Robotics and Automation that benefits members, the profession and humanity. Its vision is to be the most recognized and respected global organization in Robotics and Automation.

documents.title: VIT Chennai Campus Chapters — IEEE RAS listing
documents.text: VIT Chennai lists IEEE Robotics & Automation Society (IEEE-RAS) as a Technical Chapter among the institute's technical chapters.

documents.title: IEEE RAS VIT Chennai Chapter Initiative Grant — Sensors and Mechanical Overview
documents.text: The IEEE RAS VIT Chennai Student Chapter held a technical talk on Sensors and a Mechanical Overview in Robotics on 31 July. The session covered fundamentals of sensors and actuators and mechanical aspects of robotics, including how robot design should be framed and how materials can be selected. The talk also emphasized that robotics is multidisciplinary and discussed fundamentals of research and development of patentable products.

documents.title: VIT Chennai SENSE Newsletter — Roadmap for ML and Data Science Using Python
documents.text: On 25 February 2021, the IEEE Robotics and Automation Chapter conducted a webinar titled Roadmap for ML and Data Science Using Python. The speaker was Dhaval Patel, Software Engineer at Bloomberg LP and a YouTuber. The webinar had 65+ students from different engineering domains and introduced AI, ML and Data Science for beginners.

documents.title: IEEE RAS Complete Report 2020-21 — Robotics session
documents.text: A robotics session discussed basic aspects of robotics for beginners, robotics sub-fields, autonomous navigation and image processing. The session also discussed how students could choose robotics sub-fields based on their interests and the challenges involved in entering robotics.

documents.title: IEEE RAS Complete Report 2020-21 — Threat Intelligence in VUCA World
documents.text: On 30 March 2021, the IEEE Robotics and Automation Chapter conducted a webinar titled Threat Intelligence in VUCA World. The event had 30+ attendees and introduced threat intelligence and cybersecurity concepts.

documents.title: HackVerse: Into the Web
documents.text: HackVerse: Into the Web was a SpiderMan-themed, story-driven hackathon organized by the IEEE Robotics and Automation Society (IEEE RAS), VIT Chennai Student Chapter, as part of TechnoVIT 2026. It ran from September 1 to 2, 2026 in Chennai. The event was designed as a 24-hour journey through three progressively challenging sprints: Web-Slinger Sprint, Spider-Sense, and Multiverse. Teams had 3–5 members. The mission was to take an idea, build it, deploy it, and prove it.

documents.title: GLYTCH
documents.text: GLYTCH was a 24-hour national hackathon held December 9–10, 2025 in Chennai. It was powered by the Open Source Programming Club, Google Developer Groups, and IEEE RAS of VIT Chennai. Its theme was about distorted reality and it did not use fixed tracks.
